title: Export the audit log as CSV
body:
The owner needs to hand the audit log to an external reviewer as a spreadsheet.

- New endpoint GET /api/v1/audit.csv with the same filters as GET /api/v1/audit, streaming rows (ts, agent_id, role, tool, task_id, note) without loading everything in memory.
- Values that start with =, +, - or @ must be prefixed with a single quote to prevent formula injection.
- The web app gets a "Download CSV" button on the audit page that respects the current filters.
